stories.title: Mona Mishra may become UP Congress chief:Party bets on Brahmin face ahead of polls; father Pramod Tiwari is close to Rahul Gandhi and shares ties with Akhilesh Yadav
stories.summary: Discussion over a possible leadership change in the Congress has intensified ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, with the party considering replacing Uttar Pradesh Congress president Ajay Rai with Congress MLA and Leader of the Legislative Party Aradhana Mishra, aka Mona. However, the party has not yet made any official announcement regarding the proposed change. According to sources, Mona Mishra's name was also discussed at the Congress Working Committee (CWC) meeting held at the AICC office in New Delhi on Tuesday. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi and several other top party leaders expressed their agreement. However, one faction of the Congress is opposed to her. Mona Mishra's father, Pramod Tiwari, is currently a Rajya Sabha MP from Rajasthan and the Deputy Leader of the Opposition in the Rajya Sabha. He has been elected MLA from Pratapgarh's Rampur Khas seat nine times and has served as a former cabinet minister in the Uttar Pradesh government. He also shares good relations with Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav. Mona Mishra has been an MLA from her father's traditional seat for three consecutive terms. Ajay Rai has held the responsibility since August 2023 Ajay Rai has been president of the Uttar Pradesh Congress Committee since August 2023. The party's new Uttar Pradesh in-charge, Rajendra Pal Gautam, is the one who has demanded a change in the state Congress president. Rajendra Pal Gautam cited social equations before the party high command. He argued that the Bhumihar community, to which Ajay Rai belongs, has a very small population in the state. To win the 2027 election, the Congress needs a face with a large and broad voter base. Gautam himself comes from the Dalit community. His strategy is to win Uttar Pradesh through a Dalit-Brahmin or Dalit-OBC combination. As part of this reshuffle, the name of Pramod Tiwari's daughter and MLA, Aradhana Mishra, has emerged. There is speculation that Ajay Rai could be given another responsibility at the central level in the party. Three options before the high command: Who will get the nod? Rajendra Pal Gautam had travelled to Delhi on 10-11 September. He held a lengthy meeting with Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi and Organisation General Secretary KC Venugopal. The high command now has three options – First: Remove Ajay Rai and hand over the state leadership to a Brahmin, OBC or Dalit face. Second: Given the party's strong performance in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, Ajay Rai should be retained as president. The strongest argument in Rai's favour is that the party won six Lok Sabha seats under his leadership. He himself gave Prime Minister Narendra Modi a tough fight in Varanasi. During the counting, he also led in a total of seven rounds at different stages. Third: Ajay Rai should be retained as president, avoiding the risk of changing the party chief just four months before the election. However, to maintain a balance, three to four working presidents should be appointed alongside him. These should include Brahmin, Dalit, OBC and Muslim leaders.

stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Politics News: उत्तर प्रदेश के मंत्री नरेंद्र कश्यप ने समाजवादी पार्टी के नेता के दावों पर पलटवार किया। उन्होंने सपा के उस दावे को खोखला और झूठा बताया, जिसमें कहा गया था कि भाजपा के कई विधायक सपा के संपर्क में हैं। कश्यप ने अखिलेश यादव से भाजपा की चिंता छोड़ने को कहा और पीडीए की परिभाषा को लेकर सवाल उठाया। उन्होंने कहा कि अखिलेश यादव का असली रंग सामने आ गया है। कश्यप ने दावा किया कि भाजपा राज्यसभा में अपने सभी उम्मीदवारों को निर्वाचित कराने में सफल होगी। साथ ही उन्होंने कहा कि पीडीए विधायक भी अब अखिलेश यादव से नाराज हो रहे हैं, जिससे सपा को संकट का सामना करना पड़ सकता है।

stories.title: CISF commandant’s mother cries while hugging body:‘Wake up, my son’; wife sobs over coffin in Ambedkarnagar, killed in JK
stories.summary: The mother of CISF Assistant Commandant Ankit Kumar Pandey broke down after his body reached his ancestral village in Ambedkar Nagar on Thursday. She hugged her son’s body and repeatedly said, “My dear son, get up. O God, what has happened?” Ankit, a resident of Daulatpur Eksara (Mathia) village in Ambedkar Nagar, was killed in firing at a CISF camp at the Sewa Hydroelectric Project in Kathua, Jammu and Kashmir. His body, wrapped in the Tricolour, reached his village at around 12 noon on Thursday. Ankit's wife, Priyanka, also wept uncontrollably and repeatedly banged her head against the coffin. She also continued to support her elderly mother-in-law. His sisters Yogeshwari, Lalita, Niteshwari, Sudha, Seema and Antima were also seen sobbing. His last rites were performed at around 1:30 pm. At around 7:30 pm on Tuesday, a dispute broke out among personnel at the CISF camp over something. During the dispute, a head constable opened fire with his service rifle. CISF Commandant Ankit Pandey, Sub-Inspector Laxman Singh and four other personnel were killed. Watch the disturbing visuals below : Ankit was selected for CISF in 2016 Daultpur Eksara Mathia is a village in the Ibrahimapur police station area, around 28 km from the district headquarters. Ankit, who lived there, was the only son of retired teacher Shiv Prasad Pandey. He had six sisters and was the youngest in the family. All his sisters are married. Ankit was selected as a sub-inspector in the CISF in 2016. After passing the departmental examination in 2021, he was promoted to the rank of commandant. For around a year, he had been responsible for the security of a hydroelectric project in the Basoli area of Kathua. Before that, he was posted at Bharat Mandapam in Delhi. He married Priyanka in 2019. Ankit has a two-and-a-half-year-old son, Agastya. Patriotic slogans raised as mortal remains reached village When the family was informed of Ankit's sacrifice, the house was filled with cries of anguish. At 6 am on Thursday, his mortal remains were first brought to Lucknow airport. From there, the body was taken to Ambedkar Nagar in an Army vehicle decorated with flowers. Thousands of people were waiting there to pay their last respects. The body was wrapped in the tricolour. Seeing this, people began raising patriotic slogans. CISF battalion pays tribute Personnel from the CISF battalion based at NTPC saluted the mortal remains of martyr Ankit Kumar Pandey. His final procession then began. A large number of villagers, along with public representatives, officials and local residents, joined it. Slogans of "Long live Ankit Kumar" continued to be raised.

stories.title: Alok Kumar Pushpendra Pasi become SC Morcha general secretaries:BJP forms state team, also appoints regional presidents
stories.summary: The BJP has appointed Pushpendra Pasi, Alok Kumar, Kamlesh Jatav and Pardesi Ravidas as state general secretaries of its Scheduled Caste (SC) Morcha in Uttar Pradesh on Thursday. The party has announced the new state team while maintaining organisational balance, with the appointments also carrying several political implications. The most surprising and widely discussed name on the list is Vikas Kishore, who has been appointed state vice-president. Vikas Kishore is the son of Kaushal Kishore, the BJP's former MP from Mohanlalganj and former Union minister of state. Interestingly, Kaushal Kishore had recently raised questions about the functioning of the government and the organisation, shortly after which his son was given this major responsibility in the organisation. Besides Vikas Kishore, the BJP has appointed 11 other leaders as state vice-presidents. They include Anup Valmiki, Ashok Sonkar, Babulal Bhanwara, Charan Singh Lisadi, Bhagwati Prasad, Nand Kishore Kanaujia, Abhishek Sagar, Narendra Mahandha, Hariram Rawat, Adesh Kori and Anita Siddharth. Read the list below : The BJP has appointed Nayan Dohre, Anmol Kumar Verma, Chandrika Prasad, Manoj Jajoora, Usha Paswan, Jaiprakash Gautam, Dr Harsh Jatav, Vikas Paswan, Ravi Prakash, Ramveer Katheria, Sudhir Bhuihar and Purushottam Jatav as state ministers. Dheeraj Pradhan Valmiki has been appointed treasurer, while Rahul Sonkar and Rohit Chaudhary have been appointed deputy treasurers. Shubham Sonkar has been appointed media coordinator; Jitendra Sonkar and Rajenshwar Kumar Shrivas, deputy media coordinators; Aparajita Singh, social media coordinator; and Anuj Nag and Suraj Sonkar, deputy social media coordinators. Dr Vinod Kumar Kanaujia has been appointed head of the state research department, while Sanjay Singh and Ashwini Valmiki have been appointed deputy coordinators of the research department. The regional presidents Regional presidents of the BJP Scheduled Caste Morcha have also been appointed. Akhil Kumar has been appointed regional president for West, Vishal Valmiki for Braj, Salil Shrivas for Kanpur, Arun Rawat for Awadh, Shailesh Ram for Kashi and Vijay Sonkar for Gorakhpur.

stories.title: Fire breaks out at Blinkit store in Ghaziabad:Several cylinders explode; nearby shops evacuated, fire engines rushed from 7 stations
stories.summary: A massive fire broke out after cylinders explode at a Blinkit grocery store in Indirapuram, Ghaziabad on Thursday. Several nearby shops were engulfed as fire spread rapidly. Loud explosions were heard during the incident. The flames and thick smoke were visible from a long distance. According to information, the incident took place in Neeti Khand-1 on Kala Patthar Road. Fearing that the fire could spread, police evacuated nearby shops and moved people to a safe location. Seven fire engines from the Ghaziabad Kotwali, Vaishali and Sahibabad fire stations reached the scene. Firefighters are working to extinguish the blaze. According to the local residents, cylinders kept inside the store exploded, although this has not been officially confirmed. No casualties have been reported so far. Watch fire visuals below : An eyewitness at the scene said, “The fire started at the Blinkit grocery shop. I was at my shop when I saw smoke rising from there. I went closer and saw that the shop was on fire. This shop belongs to my brother, and furniture work is carried out here. The exact cause of the fire will be known later.” Story being updated...

stories.title: Brij Bhushan Singh says he won’t contest elections:Has personal ties with Akhilesh, says he doesn’t speak against him; ‘I’m in BJP, he’s SP leader’
stories.summary: Amid the Rajya Sabha elections in Uttar Pradesh, former BJP MP Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh on Thursday spoke about his relationship with Akhilesh Yadav and said he will not contest the 2027 Assembly elections. Speaking in Ayodhya about his growing leniency towards Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav, Brij Bhushan said that he had personal relations with Akhilesh. "We have been MPs from his party. Akhilesh is a good person," he said. Brij Bhushan went on to say, “When he praises us, we praise him too. I do not speak against him, and he does not speak against me. This should not be viewed through a political lens. I am in the BJP, and he is a leader of the SP.” He also ruled out contesting the elections and said, "I do not want to contest the Assembly elections." Brij Bhushan arrived in Ayodhya from Delhi at 2 pm and received a rousing welcome from party workers at Maharishi Valmiki International Airport. There, he gave clear indications about his political role. However, he did not say that he would stay away from politics. Dig at Keshav Maurya and the Samajwadi Party through hints Brij Bhushan Singh took a dig at Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Maurya and the Samajwadi Party without naming them. He said, "Some people say that 25 Samajwadi Party MLAs are in contact with me. Others say that BJP MLAs are in contact with me. I have nothing to say about any of this." In fact, referring to cross-voting in the Rajya Sabha election, Akhilesh Yadav claimed on Wednesday, "Several BJP MLAs are in contact with us. But the question is, how will we accommodate all of them? We do not want to make false promises to anyone and then fail to honour them." After this, Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya had said that 25 Samajwadi Party MLAs were in contact with them. Had said a day earlier: Everything is desolate without Akhilesh Congress had said that in Uttar Pradesh, it would not contest fewer than 150 seats in an alliance with the Samajwadi Party. Brij Bhushan Singh was asked about this in Delhi on Wednesday morning. In response, he had said that everything was desolate without Akhilesh. Congress had no existence in Uttar Pradesh without Akhilesh. When asked about Congress's refusal to contest fewer than 150 seats in Uttar Pradesh and Akhilesh's absence from the INDI alliance meeting, the BJP leader said, "We cannot say yet whether Akhilesh will attend. It is possible that a representative of his party may be attending the meeting, but Congress has no existence in Uttar Pradesh without Akhilesh." When asked about speculation over his going to the Rajya Sabha, Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh did not respond. In the afternoon, when asked about Brij Bhushan, the Samajwadi Party chief had said, My relations with him are very good. We are all united on the issue of Uttar Pradesh's development. Supported Baba Ramdev's statement Brij Bhushan supported yoga guru Baba Ramdev's statement that "all Muslims in Hindustan are converted". He said, "As far as Baba Ramdev's statement about the Muslim community is concerned, I have been saying this from the beginning. Seventy to 80 per cent of people in the Muslim community come from Hindu society. I had said what Baba Ramdev has said before he did."

stories.title: Akhilesh announces ₹51,000 pension for ‘democracy fighters’ if govt formed:Asked about becoming PM; says, ‘Don’t make us fight’
stories.summary: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav has made a major announcement for the defenders of democracy. He said that if his government comes to power in the state, the honorarium for these fighters will be increased to ₹51,000 per month. They will also receive free medical treatment. Just like freedom fighters, democracy fighters will also receive other facilities. Targeting the BJP government, Akhilesh said, “At present, social justice across the country is going through the BJP’s Emergency era. Any period in which the PDA is oppressed will be an Emergency.” He said that even if the BJP manages things under a microscope, it will still lose. Asked about becoming the prime minister, Akhilesh said, “Let me stay in Uttar Pradesh for now; do not make us fight among ourselves.” He was referring to Rahul Gandhi. The Samajwadi Party and the Congress are part of the INDIA alliance, with Rahul Gandhi leading the alliance. Former Chief Minister Akhilesh Yadav was addressing a press conference at the Samajwadi Party office on Thursday. During the event, he honoured Mohammad Naseem by draping a shawl around him. Naseem had carved an image of the Legislative Assembly on a tiny grain of rice. Key points from Akhilesh Yadav's press conference : Yadav said, "The police cannot be trusted; they are working as BJP workers. In this government, genuine saints have been deeply insulted and have not received justice." Taking a dig at Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak for saying that young people should drive e-rickshaws instead of seeking jobs, Yadav said, "The Deputy Chief Minister should book an e-rickshaw. This is the Deputy Chief Minister who has made hospitals sick." The former chief minister said, "The BJP will lose even if it manages the election with a microscope. Whether the BJP fields nine candidates or 10, it is going to lose this election. Anyone who wants to join hands to defeat the BJP is welcome. Even today, we are living through the same period, with inflation, unemployment and corruption at their peak." Yadav alleged that a young man in Gorakhpur who made a video showing waterlogging and corruption was booked under the Goonda Act. Taking a jibe at the Uttar Pradesh government for approaching the Supreme Court in the Noida district magistrate case, he said that lakhs of rupees were being spent to avoid a ₹5 lakh fine. He said, "As soon as this government is removed from the state, this bulldozer-style situation will also end." Asked about Minister Rajbhar's continued attacks, Yadav said, "How will those who won on the Samajwadi Party's votes win again on their own?" Smiling in response to a question, he said, "You bring Rajbhar to us and we will take him... Go and bring him, we are waiting." Yadav said that Gen Z and the PDA would wipe out the BJP in the coming days. He gave the slogan, "Ek kachori, do samosas, BJP me na koi bharosa." A major Gen Z programme will be organised soon.

stories.title: UP Shikshamitras cannot take special TET:HC rejects plea, saying their status differs from govt teachers
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh's shiksha mitras will not be able to appear for the Special TET-2026. The Allahabad High Court dismissed a petition seeking their inclusion in the exam on Thursday. Justice Manju Rani Chauhan said that the petitioners cannot claim the right to appear for the Special TET merely because they are eligible to take the regular TET. The court said the legal status of shiksha mitras is different from that of teachers employed in government service. The court further said that the Constitution does not require the state to remove a distinction if it is based on a legitimate legal objective. The petition was filed in September last year by 220 shiksha mitras, including Wasim Ahmed. They had sought an opportunity to appear for the Special TET-2026. The court reserved its judgment after the hearing was completed on September 24. About special TET examination : Special TET is a special teacher eligibility test for teachers and shikshamitra working in Uttar Pradesh. The State Education Service Selection Commission has introduced it for teachers who have not yet passed TET or CTET. Examination on 3 November Passing the TET by 2028 is mandatory In an order issued on 1 September last year, the Supreme Court made it mandatory for all serving teachers to pass the TET by 31 August 2028. Following this, teachers' organisations launched a protest demanding special relief. The government had announced that a separate special TET would be conducted for serving teachers. The plan for conducting it has now been approved. News is being updated...

stories.title: Prayagraj court summons Rambhadracharya over 'casteist' remark:He said Brahmins don’t marry into Upadhyay, Chaubey, Dixit families
stories.summary: The ACJM court in Prayagraj issued a notice to Tulsi Peethadhishwar Jagadguru Rambhadracharya over his remarks about sub-castes in the Brahmin community on Thursday. He has been asked to appear in court on October 12. A case against him will be heard in the court. The controversy began after a video of Jagadguru Rambhadracharya went viral. In the viral video, he made remarks about some sub-castes in the Brahmin community, such as Upadhyay, Chaubey, Trigunayat, Dixit and Pathak. He had said, "The Brahmin community does not marry its daughters into these sub-castes." On 14 September, Ramesh Upadhyay, a resident of Varanasi, filed an application in the ACJM court seeking to lodge a complaint. He said, "The Jagadguru's remarks have hurt the sentiments of the community, so he should be summoned and action should be taken against him." Ramesh is the national president of the Bharatiya Kisan Sena Loktantrik Party. Read what Jagadguru said in the video below : "The discussion about lowly Brahmins... inferior Brahmins was started. Some Brahmins are not considered good in our community. Families from higher lineages do not give their daughters in marriage to them. Upadhyay, Chaubey, Trigunayat, Dixit and Pathak are considered inferior because they taught students after taking money from them. "We neither give our daughters in marriage to their families nor take daughters from them. We consider taking even a single penny from a student equivalent to eating beef. I am a Saryuparin Brahmin. First, I am a Brahmin-specifically, a Brahmin of the Vashishtha gotra. Then I am a sadhu, then a sannyasi, and then Jagadguru Ramanandacharya. I am proud of my Brahmin identity." Petitioner said-Statement has begun creating obstacles to children's marriages Ramesh Upadhyay filed an application to lodge a complaint at ACJM Court No. 8 on 14 September, accompanied by his lawyer, Kamla Prasad. The application stated that Jagadguru Rambhadracharya is a saint whom people worship. It said that after his remarks during a Bhagwat Katha in Vrindavan on 3 February 2024, people had begun looking down upon the Upadhyay community. According to the petitioner, boys and girls from the community had begun facing difficulties in getting married. He said he had met the Prayagraj Police Commissioner and filed a complaint in the matter on 22 May 2025. He had also sent a complaint by post, but no action was taken. "After this, I am filing a complaint case in court. It is necessary to take action against him in the interest of justice."

stories.title: ‘Blue drum’ Muskaan-Sahil break down after verdict:Restless in jail, ate little; judge calls crime ‘frightening’
stories.summary: The blue drum case took an emotional turn as Muskan and her lover Sahil started crying as the judge announced the verdict on Thursday. When Meerut District Judge Arvind Kumar Mishra asked them what sentence should be given to them, both remained silent before breaking down. The court later deferred the decision on their sentence until October 14. The judge made the remarks while delivering the verdict in the high-profile case. They both were convicted of killing Muskan's husband, Saurabh Rajput, and hiding his body in a blue drum. The judge said such crimes create fear and insecurity in society and affect the way people think. He said a rise in crime is a matter of concern and that the justice system must assure people of their safety and maintain their faith in the law. He also said the court's responsibility is not limited to punishing the crime and the accused. It must also take into account the rights of the accused and the interests of society. According to jail sources, following the verdict, Muskan and Sahil remained restless in their barrack. They kept crying and ate little at night. In view of their condition, jail authorities increased surveillance on them. Judge says dismembering hiding a body is a heinous crime The final arguments in the case were heard on 19 September. The court set 30 September for pronouncing the verdict. District Judge Arvind Kumar Mishra entered the courtroom at 4:30 pm on Wednesday. Muskan and Sahil were connected from Meerut jail via video conference. The judge saw both of them on the screen. He first named Sahil Shukla, followed by Muskan Rastogi. The judge said, "the statements of the witnesses and the evidence have proved that both of them murdered Saurabh Rajput. To destroy the evidence, they cut the body into pieces and packed them in a blue drum. This is a heinous crime. The court declares both of them guilty." Deceased's mother and brother began crying as soon as the verdict was pronounced After hearing the verdict, Saurabh's brother Rahul and mother Renu Devi became emotional and began to cry. After the verdict, Saurabh's lawyers KK Chaubey and Vijay Bahadur folded their hands and thanked the court, urging it to sentence both of them to death. After the verdict, Muskan and Sahil will not be transferred to another prison. Both will remain in Meerut Jail. The prison administration has increased surveillance of both of them. Senior Jail Superintendent Dr Veeresh Raj Sharma said: Muskaan has been performing prayers for more than three days. Sahil also remains quiet. Jail staff are keeping a constant watch on both their behaviour. A counsellor's help will be sought if necessary. No one has come to meet Muskaan in jail in the past 17 months. stories.title: Yogi says ACS called former DGP without doing homework:Says such formalities put system in dock
stories.summary: Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh Yogi Adityanath criticised the practice of unnecessary formalities while addressing a programme in Lucknow on Thursday. He reprimanded Additional Chief Secretary (Home) Sanjay Prasad over the formal phone call made to former DGP Prakash Singh. The CM said, “It is because of such formalities that you people end up in the dock. Put an end to these formalities and hold programmes with full preparation.” Yogi Adityanath awarded medals to 26 brave police personnel at the programme. Ten of them received the Chief Minister’s Gallantry Medal, while 16 received the Gallantry Medal. The CM also released former DGP Prakash Singh’s book, Sangharsh, and flagged off 87 high-tech police vehicles. The CM said, “Whenever a person tries to take a shortcut, it leads not to progress but to decline. It creates a crisis of identity for the person. That is exactly what Uttar Pradesh was facing. What was the situation before 2017? People would immediately exclude someone simply by saying he was from Uttar Pradesh.”

stories.title: Passenger falls asleep in Varanasi airport parking:Misses Dubai flight; people say Gorakhpur man was drunk
stories.summary: A drunk passenger missed his flight to Dubai after falling asleep at the parking area of Varanasi's Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport on Wednesday evening. He lay down in the car park after drinking alcohol and remained there for a long time, during which his flight took off. Local residents later informed the police. The police reached the spot and sent the passenger to hospital in an ambulance. His family members were also informed about the incident. After he sobered up on Thursday morning, the passenger returned home. He had come from Gorakhpur to travel to Dubai Bhabhishan Kumar, a resident of Barhalganj in Gorakhpur, was scheduled to travel to Dubai on Air India Express flight IX-183. He reached Varanasi Airport at around 5:30 pm on Wednesday. The flight was scheduled to depart for Dubai at 9 pm. After reaching the airport, he drank alcohol and later lay down in the parking area in an intoxicated state. He remained there until his flight departed. Drunk man abuses taxi drivers when they tried to wake him up Taxi drivers and passengers passing through the parking area noticed the man lying there and tried to wake him. However, they moved away after noticing the smell of alcohol and hearing him abuse them. The passenger remained in the parking area for a long time, during which his Dubai-bound flight also departed. Police sent him to hospital in an ambulance Upon receiving information, a team from Phulpur police station reached the spot and found the passenger in an unconscious state. The police called an ambulance and sent him to the Primary Health Centre in Baragaon, where he was given treatment. Babhatpur outpost in-charge Vijay Kushwaha said the passenger's family was informed about the incident through his mobile phone. He said the passenger could not board the flight because he was heavily intoxicated. By the time he regained consciousness at night, the flight had already departed. After regaining consciousness, the passenger realised his mistake and left for home on Thursday morning.

stories.title: FIR against 20, including SP councillor, on court order:Accused of grabbing temple land in Gorakhpur; councillor says, ‘Will present my side in court’
stories.summary: Police have registered a case against 20 people, including Samajwadi Party councillor Vijendra Agrahari, following a court order over allegations of attempting to encroach on land belonging to Shri Thakurji Hanuman Temple in Hanumanchak, under Gorakhpur’s Rajghat police station. The case was filed on a complaint by Ramprakash Das, the temple’s caretaker. Allegation of forged documents and illegal construction records Ramprakash Das alleged that forged documents related to the temple land were prepared with the intention of selling and encroaching on it. He said the land is recorded in the temple’s name and that he is its successor and sarvarakar on the basis of a registered will dated December 15, 1998. According to the complaint, some people allegedly obtained house tax and building/plot numbers from the municipal corporation for the temple land even though no houses had been constructed there. Sale deeds and other documents were subsequently prepared for the land on different dates. Soil allegedly dumped on temple land using JCB in January According to the complaint, councillor Vijendra Agrahari allegedly began filling the temple land with soil using a JCB on January 5. Temple priest Kamaldas reportedly reached the spot after learning about the work and stopped it. The complainant alleged that the priest was abused and threatened with death when he objected. ‘Returned with tractor-trolley to dump soil in August’ Ramprakash Das alleged that on August 20, Agrahari returned to the disputed land with his associates in a tractor-trolley and began dumping soil again. He claimed that those who objected were threatened with death if they did not vacate the land. Das maintained that the temple land is recorded in government documents and that he had never sold it. He subsequently sought legal action against those named in the complaint. Following the court’s order, Rajghat police registered the case and began an investigation. Case registered against 20 people The accused named in the case are Vijendra Agrahari, Ramavatar, Digvijaynath, Ashok Kumar Agrahari, Chandragupta, Sushila Lohia, Satya Prakash, Shalini Gupta, Ranjeet, Arvind Jaiswal, Vimla, Krishna Prakash, Jyoti Prakash, Piyush Gupta, Imran Khan, Krishna Murari, Krishnakant Sharma, Vinay Kumar, Pankaj Kumar and Surendra Kumar. Councillor denies allegations, says he executed sale deed in 2018 Vijendra Agrahari denied the allegations. He said he had executed a sale deed for the land in 2018 and would present his case before the court, adding that the allegations against him were baseless.

stories.title: Ganga water reaches Namo Ghat platform in Varanasi:Connectivity cut off to 84 ghats; boatmen pray, ‘Mother Ganga, please calm down’
stories.summary: The weather has begun to change once again in Varanasi. The city recorded a temperature of 30°C on Thursday morning. Wind speed was around 8 kilometres per hour, while humidity remained at 69 per cent. The city's air quality index (AQI) was recorded at 99. According to meteorologist Prof. Manoj Srivastava, there is no possibility of rain or cloudy conditions over the next week. During this period, temperatures may rise by one to two degrees Celsius. However, the weather will remain slightly cool in the mornings. Ganga water level rising Meanwhile, the rising water level of the Ganga has once again begun changing the condition of the ghats. Water has returned to the ghats where it had receded in recent days, and cleaning of the steps and platforms has begun. The Ganga has reached the platform at Namo Ghat. Water has also reached the steps at Assi Ghat. In addition, 84 ghats remain cut off from the mainland. As the Ganga's water level rises, problems have increased at the ghats where cleaning had been carried out after the floodwaters receded. With the water returning, the silt and rubbish accumulated there will have to be cleared again. The shortage of space at the ghats is also causing difficulties for people arriving to perform pind daan and other religious rituals. With devotees moving in and out during Pitru Paksha, the limited space has made arrangements at the ghats challenging. Boats have not operated for two months, increasing boatmen's concern The Ganga's constantly changing water level and the condition of the ghats have also affected the boatmen's livelihoods. The boatmen said boat operations have been affected for around two months. This has made it difficult to support their families. They said they were praying to Mother Ganga for the water level to settle and the condition of the ghats to return to normal so that boat operations could resume.

stories.title: 20,000 people affected in Gomti river floods:Water enters several Lucknow villages and submerges crops; locals wait for relief
stories.summary: The rising water level of the Gomti River has worsened the situation in the low-lying areas of Itaunja in Lucknow. Several villages, including Sultanpur, Bahadurpur, Lasa, Akadariya Khurd, Akadariya Kala, Hirapurwa, Jamkhanwa and Dughra, are affected by flooding. Around 20,000 people are reportedly affected. Roads connecting several villages have been submerged, disrupting movement in the area. With floodwater reaching homes, some families have been forced to move to safer locations. Schoolchildren, women and elderly residents are also relying on boats to travel. Villagers said several boats do not have adequate safety equipment, including life jackets, raising concerns about their safety. What are the villagers demanding? Which areas are at risk? Read about it in this ground report by Dainik Bhaskar... First, take a look at six photographs... Roads submerged, children using boats to reach school The rising Gomti has disrupted road connectivity between villages. Water has made several routes difficult to cross on foot or by vehicle, forcing residents to use boats. Children are also using boats to reach school, while women and elderly residents have limited options for travelling. Villagers said the lack of adequate safety equipment on boats could lead to accidents. Floodwater enters homes, families move to safer places After floodwater entered homes, some families moved to safer locations. Those who remain in the villages are facing difficulties in arranging food and other daily essentials. Arranging fodder for livestock has also become difficult. Villagers have demanded that relief materials be provided to affected families and fodder be arranged for their animals. Paddy, okra and 'sebi' crops destroyed Ram Devi of Bahadurpur village said she had planted paddy, but the entire crop was submerged in floodwater. Her okra and 'sebi' crops were also damaged. She said the income from the 'sebi' crop helped support her family. She had used money earned from selling wheat to grow paddy, but that investment has now been lost. Ram Devi said, “I invested the money from selling wheat in paddy farming. Now the paddy has also been submerged. The okra and sebi crops have also been damaged. The District Magistrate visited, but we did not receive any help.” Ramu: Entire village flooded, no relief received Ramu, a resident of Bahadurpur, said the entire village was flooded and people were facing major difficulties in travelling. He said the District Magistrate had visited the village for an inspection, but residents had still not received relief. Villagers have demanded that essential facilities be provided in the affected areas at the earliest. The DM had conducted an inspection On Monday, District Magistrate Vishakh G. Iyer had inspected flood-affected areas, including Lasa and Akdariya Kala. He spoke to the villagers to assess the situation and directed officials to provide relief as needed. The administration had also instructed officials to arrange additional boats and provide health services. Meanwhile, according to the villagers, ADM Supply Jyoti Gautam had also visited the flood-affected area. The villagers allege that she had photographs taken during her inspection at the site and then left. They still did not receive any relief. Residents seek relief and safety measures Villagers have urged the administration to provide relief materials, fodder for livestock and safe transport arrangements for affected families. They have also sought life jackets and other safety equipment for boats. Farmers whose crops have been damaged by the floods have also sought financial assistance. Villagers said that even after the water recedes, they will face the challenge of restarting farming.

stories.title: 2 sadhus killed and bodies burnt in Shahjahanpur:Bodies set on fire on a wooden pyre inside Shiva temple; smoke alerted people
stories.summary: Two sadhus were allegedly murdered at a temple in Shahjahanpur district, and their bodies were later set on fire. According to the information, villagers reached the temple at around 7 am on Thursday after noticing smoke rising from the premises. They found one sadhu’s body still burning, while the other’s body had been reduced to a skeleton. Bodies found 10 metres apart The two bodies were found around 10 metres apart. The incident took place in Khudaganj, around 70 km from the district headquarters. The deceased have been identified as Baba Gopal Das and Baba Bihari Das. Both lived at a temple in Sutha village under Khudaganj police station limits. Know the full details Villagers said sadhu Gopal Das (70), a resident of Azizganj locality, was a storyteller who had been living at the temple for around 20 years. Bihar Das (60) was from the same village. He had earlier lived at the Thakur Ji temple in Sutha village and became Gopal Das’s disciple a month ago. The two then began living at the Shiva temple. Pradeep Singh, nephew of Baba Bihar Das, alleged that a local youth, Sumit, carried out the killings. He claimed Sumit had attacked the two sadhus several times in the past. Dragpal, who cleaned the temple, said he reached the temple at around 7 am and found the bodies burning. He said he had not met the sadhus at night and had last seen them at around 3 pm on Wednesday before returning home.

stories.title: Where will former IAS Divya Mittal contest from?:Mirzapur or join Raja Bhaiya; will she form new party?
stories.summary: Former IAS officer Divya Mittal is set to enter politics. A viral photograph with Raja Bhaiya and her past disputes with Anupriya Patel in Mirzapur have fuelled speculation in political circles. She has also received offers to join the Samajwadi Party (SP) and Congress. Despite this, she does not want to join any political party. This has raised three major questions: Here are the answers, one by one… 1. Where could Divya Mittal contest an election? Three possible options are being discussed for Divya Mittal’s political debut. First, she could begin her political career by contesting the Mirzapur Sadar Assembly seat. When she was transferred in 2023, people in Mirzapur gave her a flower-filled farewell. Second, she could contest from Chunar. People in the region still remember the grand Chunar Mahotsav organised during her tenure. The constituency has a sizeable Kurmi and Dalit population, and the BJP is considered strong there. Third, instead of contesting the Assembly election herself, Divya Mittal could field some of her supporters from Mirzapur. She could then directly challenge Anupriya Patel in the 2029 Lok Sabha election. However, political experts believe that this is the right time for a non-political person to enter politics. The Lok Sabha election is still some time away. Rather than waiting until then, they suggest she could build her political profile by contesting an Assembly election. How strong is Divya’s public connect in Mirzapur? Divya Mittal’s biggest political asset is considered to be her administrative record and direct engagement with the public. After her transfer in 2023, local leaders and villagers publicly praised her work. Her efforts to bring water to Lahuriyadih, in particular, earned her recognition in rural areas. Following her resignation, she also raised questions about why a secondary school approved during her tenure in Lahuriyadih had still not been built. Her remarks prompted officials to move quickly to begin construction. This is why her supporters argue that Mirzapur could be her natural political base if she contests an election. Divya Mittal also has considerable support among the Mirzapur Gram Pradhan Association. Several village heads even have her tie a rakhi on their wrists. Despite no longer being posted in Mirzapur, she continued to help secure development projects in several villages through her administrative contacts. Support from the village heads’ association could prove to be a major political asset during an election. 2. Could she also take on Anupriya Patel? First dispute: Divya Mittal served in Mirzapur from September 2022 to September 2023. During this period, her most widely discussed achievement was bringing water to Lahuriyadih village. A water-worship ceremony was held after the water supply reached the village, but a controversy arose because local elected representatives were not invited. The incident was linked to differences between her and Union Minister and Mirzapur MP Anupriya Patel. Lahuriyadih falls within both the Mirzapur Lok Sabha constituency and the Chhanbey Assembly constituency. At the time, Anupriya Patel was the MP from Mirzapur, while the Chhanbey seat was held by Apna Dal (S). Second dispute: This concerned Acharya Ramchandra Shukla Park and the Kajri Memorial. As District Magistrate, Divya Mittal had the memorial built in the park in Mirzapur city with public contributions. The inauguration was scheduled for 2 September 2023, with Union Minister Anupriya Patel set to attend. Anupriya Patel’s husband, Ashish Patel, reportedly became upset over the name of the park. Third dispute: This arose over the Chunar Mahotsav. Divya Mittal repeatedly sought dates from Anupriya Patel for the festival but could not secure a suitable date. She subsequently organised a grand Chunar Mahotsav without Anupriya Patel. This further deepened their differences. Following these incidents, Divya Mittal was transferred and kept on a waiting list for around 10 months. Local residents still call her ‘DM Beti’. Speculation has now emerged that she could challenge Anupriya Patel in the Lok Sabha election after establishing herself through an Assembly contest. 3. How likely is she to join Raja Bhaiya? Dr Brijesh Singh Rajawat, a leader of the Jansatta Dal Loktantrik, shared a photograph on social media on 29 September. The caption read: “IAS experience + Raja Bhaiya’s grassroots influence = a new direction?” The post went viral. Raja Bhaiya’s party has a regional political base. Speculation began that an association with the party could give Divya organisational strength. However, she has repeatedly made it clear that she will not join any political party. For now, this remains speculation. Why the BJP, SP and Congress may not be options for Divya Mittal After Divya Mittal’s resignation, speculation emerged that she was receiving behind-the-scenes support from the BJP. However, she has herself dismissed any such possibility. Following her resignation, she raised concerns about the poor condition of schools and other problems in the state, directly questioning the state government. BJP leader Prashant Umrao questioned her resignation on social media, linking it to an alleged meeting with Rahul Gandhi. Divya later rejected these allegations, saying that such accusations were intended to intimidate a woman and discourage her from entering politics. Now, regarding the possibility of her joining the SP or Congress, SP chief Akhilesh Yadav made an open offer to Divya Mittal while speaking to the media on 30 September. He said that the former IAS officer should now wear a green and red scarf, the colours associated with the SP. Following Divya Mittal’s resignation, Akhilesh Yadav was among the first to link it to the functioning of the government. He said that honest officers were being troubled under the BJP government and that corruption was preventing officials from doing their jobs. Similarly, Congress state president Ajay Rai was asked whether the party would offer Divya a ticket if she decided to contest an election. Rai said the party could consider anyone who wanted to work for society and contest an election. However, Divya clarified her position on 29 September. She said, “I cannot stand under the flags under which no one has been held accountable for 80 years and demand accountability.” Rather than joining a particular party, she is talking about changing the system. This stance points towards an independent political experiment outside the BJP, SP and Congress. Statements made by Divya Mittal after her resignation Why did Divya Mittal choose Uttar Pradesh for her political career? Divya Mittal, who studied at IIT Delhi and IIM Bengaluru, has served as District Magistrate of districts such as Sant Kabir Nagar, Mirzapur and Deoria. She originally belongs to Haryana. This means Haryana was also an option for her political career, apart from Uttar Pradesh. People who know Divya Mittal closely say that her administrative career was spent in Uttar Pradesh, where she built relationships that remain strong even after her resignation. Her statements since resigning can be divided into three broad categories. ‘It remains to be seen how far she can go alone in an election’ Senior journalist Suresh Bahadur Singh says her statements are anti-establishment and focused on public concerns. She is presenting herself as a ‘voice’ distinct from traditional politicians. While this approach has emotional appeal, her organisational weaknesses are also evident. By choosing the independent route, she has distanced herself from major parties. This may give her an independent image, but it remains to be seen how far she can go alone in the current electoral environment.

stories.title: 15-ft potholes on Gorakhpur Link Expressway:Road broken up to 5 ft, patchwork washed away in rain; hard to drive at 100 kmph
stories.summary: The Link Expressway connecting the Purvanchal Expressway to Gorakhpur has deteriorated. There are potholes at 74 places on a 45-km stretch of the 91-km-long Link Expressway. Some are 10 to 15 feet long, while others are half a foot deep. At several places, the road has cracked in the middle. The company that built the expressway has filled these potholes with gravel, but the gravel can also be seen spread far across the road. Wherever the patchwork has come off, deep potholes have appeared again. This ruins the experience of a ‘comfortable journey’. It also becomes difficult to maintain a speed of 100 kmph. It is not that the expressway was built in a hurry. It took five years to complete. It has only four lanes. A total of Rs 7,283 crore was spent on its construction, which means an average of Rs 80 crore was spent to build each kilometre. This includes the cost of land acquisition. Know the condition of the expressway step by step… While travelling from Lucknow on the Purvanchal Expressway, we reached the Gorakhpur Link Expressway. Around 3 km ahead, after crossing the toll booth, fresh patchwork was visible on the road. At several places, the patchwork was 50 to 100 metres long. When the car was driven at speed, it was bouncing over the potholes. Our car travelled around 10 km through Jogipur, Banwaripatti and Chandrabhanpur. During this stretch, we found the road damaged at 20 more places. Attempts had been made to repair these spots, but the gravel had spread far across the road with the tyres of vehicles. Several vehicles passing in front of us were travelling while avoiding these potholes. Near Katoi and Sheikhpura, the expressway had broken right in the middle. A little further ahead, in Barhalganj, we found the road broken at several places over a long stretch. We got down and counted the potholes; there were around 20. The road had cracked in the middle. A pothole more than half a foot deep had formed here. It was more than 10 feet wide. This was not limited to one spot; there were four such potholes within a 100-metre stretch. It appeared that these had been filled only a few days earlier, but the gravel and asphalt had now come out of the potholes and accumulated on the road, forming bumps. In other words, there is a pothole on one side of the road and a 1-foot-high bump right next to it on the other side. The road has also sunk at this spot. A drain-like depression has formed in the middle. During rainfall, instead of flowing towards the side, water collects at the same spot. This further damages the road. However, after this, the road remained in good condition for around 25 km. Travellers said, ‘This is not even like Lucknow’s Kisan Path’ While travelling on the expressway, we met Barabanki resident Pankaj Verma at the toll plaza. Pankaj said- This is not like the Purvanchal Expressway or the Agra Expressway. In fact, I would say that it is not even like Lucknow’s Kisan Path; there are too many potholes on it. Some other people, like Pankaj, also said that travelling on this expressway is not easy. You are driving a car at 100 kmph, and then suddenly potholes appear, causing the vehicle to go out of control several times. 22 damaged spots found while returning to Lucknow After travelling 91 km from the Purvanchal Expressway to Gorakhpur, we started our return journey towards Lucknow. Now, we had to inspect the other stretch of the road. The first around 30 km of the road looked good. We reached the 50-km mark. Potholes started appearing on the expressway again. The road near Kukripur, Borajpur and Dahiya Buzurg villages was damaged. During the return journey, we found 22 potholes in all. DBL company’s construction found to be worse During our journey on the Link Expressway, we found the road damaged at a total of 74 places. At several places, the patchwork had already come off. At many places, patchwork had not been done at all. We did not include the smaller potholes. As the expressway has started deteriorating, the company that built it has also come under discussion. It was built in two phases by two different companies. First stretch- From Jaitpur in Gorakhpur to Phulwaria was built by APCO Infratech. Second stretch- The stretch from Phulwaria to Salarpur was built by Dilip Buildcon Limited (DBL). On the ground, the work by APCO Infratech appeared better than that of DBL. In other words, the road built by DBL has deteriorated faster. You cannot drive at a speed of 80-90 kmph. Potholes at several places make the journey difficult. The possibility of accidents remains. Gorakhpur Link Expressway built to reduce travel time by 3 hours This expressway directly connects Gorakhpur to the Purvanchal Expressway near Azamgarh (Salarpur), making travel from Gorakhpur to Lucknow, Agra and Delhi easier. With its construction, the time taken to travel from Gorakhpur to Lucknow has been reduced by around 2 to 3 hours. When construction began in February 2020, its budget was Rs 5,876 crore. But by the time it was completed in 2025, the final budget had reached Rs 7,283 crore. The Gorakhpur Link Expressway has a total of 7 flyovers, 8 major bridges, 14 minor bridges and more than 100 underpasses. In 2023, when the expressway was under construction, the Ghaghra River changed its course near Kamahariaghat. This created difficulties in construction. The work was halted. The alignment was then changed and the bridge was made longer. On June 20, 2025, CM Yogi Adityanath inaugurated this four-lane expressway. Two-year agreement for toll collection At present, Highway Infrastructure Limited collects toll on this expressway. It has a two-year agreement, worth Rs 220 crore 66 lakh. Rs 105 crore has been fixed for the first year and Rs 115 crore for the second year, with a 10% increase. This means the company will have to pay around Rs 30 lakh per day to UPEIDA. The company will also have to deploy four vehicles for patrolling. Their job is to reduce road damage and the possibility of accidents. Who is responsible for filling potholes on the expressway? According to the official UPEIDA website, if any kind of damage occurs on the Gorakhpur Link Expressway during the five years after its inauguration (June 20, 2025), the responsibility lies with the two companies that built it. Both companies have appointed employees who repair the road from time to time. UPEIDA does not have to bear any expense for the repairs. So far, both companies have made public how much they have spent on repairs. If a complaint about potholes is received, repairs are carried out within 24 hours. Where there is major damage, it can take 2 to 10 days.

stories.title: Owaisi says Muslims belong to no one:Claims BJP-Akhilesh have a ‘fixed match’; one demolishes mosques, madrasas, the other takes Muslim votes
stories.summary: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi strongly criticised the Samajwadi Party and the parties part of the INDI alliance in Shravasti on Sunday evening. He said, "Muslims in Uttar Pradesh or the country are not any political party's fiefdom. Muslims are not your hereditary property. We are human beings, not just voters. If you consider us your hereditary property, you will find out what that means in the upcoming Assembly elections." Owaisi alleged that the Samajwadi Party took votes from Muslims but built its palaces of power by shattering their dreams. He told Muslims, "There is no need to be afraid or panic. The BJP must certainly be stopped. The BJP should not form the government here for a third time." Now, read about Owaisi's 4 major points... 37 graveyards and shrines demolished: A large number of madrasas were shut down in Uttar Pradesh, and bulldozers were used to demolish more than 18 madrasas. Around 37 graveyards and shrines were also demolished. Why did Samajwadi Party workers not reach the spot during this period? SP workers did not come because they know that these are symbols of poor Muslims. This system of injustice must now be ended. Why so much hatred for mosques and madrasas: Why does CM Yogi hate mosques, madrasas and graveyards so much? Madrasas impart knowledge and teach people to become better human beings. Discipline is taught at shrines and khanqahs, but the Chief Minister has a problem with these institutions. Match fixed between BJP and SP: Owaisi said that a "fixed match" was being played between Yogi and Akhilesh. According to him, Yogi demolishes madrasas and religious sites on one side, while Akhilesh works to consolidate Muslim votes on the other. Now, Asaduddin Owaisi, a man of principles, has emerged between the two. Owaisi planted his flag: I want to tell the people and leaders of the Samajwadi Party and these so-called secular parties, remember, you keep saying that if Owaisi enters the fray, the votes will be divided. Listen, Samajwadi people, this is not your feast, and we are not guests at your feast. This is not your feast, and we are not guests at your feast. This politics is a fair of Indian democracy, and in this Indian politics, Owaisi has come and planted his flag, and this flag will continue to fly. Rally had been postponed on 27 September due to bad weather This AIMIM public meeting was originally scheduled for 27 September but was cancelled due to bad weather. Owaisi held the meeting at Bhinga market at 5 p.m. on Sunday. Haji Daddan Khan, who was expelled from the BSP, is a potential candidate for the Bhinga Assembly seat. Daddan Khan was the BSP candidate from the Shravasti seat in the 2024 Lok Sabha election. After joining the AIMIM, Daddan Khan held a roadshow in September. Police registered a case against AIMIM state president Shaukat Ali, Daddan Khan and several others on charges of holding the roadshow without permission. Owaisi on alliance: We have conveyed our position to Akhilesh Asaduddin Owaisi said in Lucknow on Sunday, "We say that we will not roll out the carpet; we are not a vote bank. We should get our rightful share. Obviously, those who do not accept this truth must be feeling troubled." In an alliance with the Samajwadi Party, Owaisi said, "Our party has made its position clear. We have also cited the example of Bihar. Whatever alliance is formed will be announced to you." AIMIM state president Shaukat Ali made a major statement. He said that if an alliance is formed without Muslim leadership and without AIMIM being part of it, it would not be an alliance but a deception. Such an alliance would exploit society's oppressed, Muslim, deprived and exploited sections.

stories.title: Police bring Atiq Ahmed's shooter Arman to Uttar Pradesh:Parents fear an encounter; spent 3 years in Gaya jail
stories.summary: UP Police are bringing Armaan, an accused in the Umesh Pal murder case in Prayagraj, from Gaya jail. At around 6 p.m. on Sunday, the police received a copy of the transit remand order. Armaan was then taken into custody. He was brought out of Gaya Central Jail in the presence of Bihar Police. The police had him medically examined. He was then taken by road to Prayagraj. Teams from the UP and Bihar police are accompanying him. Armaan will be produced before the Prayagraj district court on Monday. The police will involve him in the investigation into the Umesh Pal murder case. UP Police had been searching for Armaan since the Umesh Pal murder case. It later emerged that he was lodged in Gaya jail in another case. The UP Police then began the process of obtaining transit remand to bring him to Prayagraj. Armaan was a shooter for mafia don Atiq Ahmed. Two pictures of shooter Armaan... Family says, Police did not inform us After learning that Armaan was being taken to Uttar Pradesh, his father, Shameem, and mother, Asgari Khatoon, began fearing a police encounter. They said their son could be killed in an encounter as soon as he was taken to Uttar Pradesh. Arman's father had filed an application in the Gaya court, seeking that Arman not be handed over to the Uttar Pradesh Police. He said that if the police needed to question him, it should be done via video conference. Mother says he is being made a scapegoat Accused Arman's father, Shamim, said, "Most of the accused in the Umesh Pal murder case have already been killed in police encounters. Arman could also be killed in an encounter in the name of recovering a weapon." Arman's mother, Asgari Khatun, said, "My son is being made a scapegoat. Our family is very poor. We do not even have a permanent house of our own to live in." She said Arman had previously lived in Prayagraj, where he did odd jobs. He is not a professional criminal or a major shooter. He has been in jail for the past three years. She appealed to Chief Minister Yogi and the administration to ensure Arman's safety. Arman's younger brother, Imran, said, "We had already expressed fears that my brother's life was in danger. The Uttar Pradesh Police have now taken him to Prayagraj. We fear that something untoward may happen to Arman too. The family will accept whatever verdict the court delivers. But Arman must not be harmed in any way." Armaan's lawyer says jail administration and police colluded Armaan's parents' application was heard on 1 October in the court of Gaya magistrate Saurabh Kumar. The court had rejected the application filed by Armaan's family and lawyer. Armaan's lawyer, Lalit Kumar Gupta, confirmed this. The lawyer accused the police and jail administration. He said, "Armaan's life is in danger. He could be killed in Uttar Pradesh. A conspiracy is being hatched to kill Mohammad Armaan in collusion with the Uttar Pradesh Police and the Gayaji Central Jail administration." We had sought a court appearance via video conference, citing security concerns, but the court rejected the request. Armaan has been lodged in Gaya jail since 27 February 2023. He is being deliberately framed in a case in Uttar Pradesh. Now know how the Uttar Pradesh Police reached Gayaji Jail The Uttar Pradesh Police had been searching for Armaan for the past three years. During this period, it learnt that he was lodged in Gayaji Central Jail. After receiving the information, police from Prayagraj's Dhoomanganj police station reached Gayaji Jail on 30 September. There, the police took Armaan's latest photograph and obtained his thumb impressions on plain paper. After completing the paperwork, the police returned to Prayagraj. It then filed an application for transit remand in the Gaya court on 1 October. Armaan was seen firing alongside Guddu Muslim Umesh Pal and his two government gunners were shot dead in broad daylight in Prayagraj on 24 February 2023. CCTV footage of the incident also emerged. A motorbike rider was seen in the footage. According to the police, Armaan was riding the motorbike, while Guddu Muslim was seated behind him. Armaan had brought Guddu Muslim to the scene on the motorbike. As soon as the motorbike stopped, Guddu Muslim began firing. Armaan also opened fire. After the crime, the two fled the scene on the motorbike.

His mother can be seen lying on a hospital bed, while Pawan Singh is seen hugging her. Along with the picture, Pawan Singh wrote, “Maai hamar duniya” (My mother is my world). After the post surfaced, his fans have been praying for his mother’s speedy recovery. Pawan’s close friend Priyanshu Singh also shared a picture of Pratima Devi from the hospital. He said that Pawan Singh’s mother is unwell and appealed to people to pray for her speedy recovery and long life. Wife Jyoti shared VIDEO, wished her a long life Pawan Singh’s wife, Jyoti Singh, also shared pictures and a video of her mother-in-law, Pratima Devi, on social media. She wished her a speedy recovery and prayed to God to bless Pratima Devi with good health and a long life. Pawan is very close to his mother Pawan Singh is known to be very close to his mother. He has spoken about his affection for her on several occasions. Recently, he was also seen massaging his mother’s feet in the promo of his reality show ‘Bhojpuri Bawal’. After news of his mother’s ill health emerged, his fans have been continuously wishing for her speedy recovery. Power Star Pawan Singh released a new song titled ‘Maai’ on Saturday. Pawan Singh himself has sung the song. The lyrics have been written by Prince Priyadarshi, while Priyanshu Singh is its music director.

stories.title: ‘If anyone raises a hand, cut it off’:Minister Sanjay Nishad says, ‘We have given the order, we will get you bail’
stories.summary: A Nishad Party public meeting was held in Sultanpur on Sunday. Cabinet minister and Nishad Party president Dr Sanjay Nishad also arrived at around 4 p.m. He told workers at the meeting, "If anyone raises a hand against you, then after today, the order from us is... break or cut off his hand and throw it away. We will get you bail." Dr Sanjay Nishad also appealed to supporters to hoist the Nishad Party flag at every home. He said, "This flag is a guarantee of the children's future, education, respect and security. If a leader of another party comes to your neighbourhood carrying a flag, chase him away instead of welcoming him." Said-Do not press the button bearing another party's election symbol A public meeting of the Nishad Party was held near Patna Chauraha in Kurebhar. Targeting the Samajwadi Party and Bahujan Samaj Party, Sanjay Nishad raised the issues of jobs and political representation. He said pressing the button bearing another party's election symbol meant that others benefited from the jobs. He appealed to workers to raise the 'Jai Nishad Raj' flag and strengthen the organisation. Jail is the place for people with a feudal mindset Dr Sanjay Nishad recently referred to a video showing a member of the Nishad community being assaulted and abused in Gorakhpur. He said that people with a feudal mindset were subjecting members of society to atrocities. "I will always stand at the forefront to defend the honour and dignity of the community. Jail is the only place for such people." Referring to the Faizabad incident, he said strict action had been taken after he raised in the Legislative Assembly the case involving atrocities against a daughter of the Nishad community. He also referred to the bulldozer action. We must fight an all-out battle for reservation Sanjay Nishad also raised the issue of reservation by seeking the inclusion of the fishing community in the SC category. He told workers to continue the struggle and remain prepared for an all-out battle to secure the implementation of reservation. He stressed the need to ensure education for children, employment and access to the benefits of government schemes. In view of the upcoming Assembly election, he urged workers to remain active in every village and strengthen the organisation down to the booth level. Workers arrived at the programme from several districts, including Amethi, Ambedkar Nagar, Azamgarh, Mau, Ayodhya and Pratapgarh, besides Sultanpur. A large crowd gathered at the venue. Women also participated. When Dr Sanjay Nishad arrived, the workers raised slogans of "Jai Nishad Raj".

stories.title: 5 feet of water in 40,000 Lucknow homes:Cars submerged, food supplies soaked; patients carried out on cots
stories.summary: The flood situation has become serious in Lucknow. Water levels in the Gomti River have been rising rapidly for the sixth consecutive day. The Faizullaganj area is the worst affected. Water, four to five feet deep, has accumulated in 40,000 homes. Three lakh people have been affected. More than 2,000 people are leaving their homes every day for other neighbourhoods or relatives' houses. Water has reached Hanumant Dham and Lete Hanuman, located along the Gomti Riverfront, as well as Chandrika Devi Temple in Bakshi ka Talab. The administration has temporarily closed the Food Valley near the Gomti Riverfront and Marine Drive. Boats have been deployed to help people. Residents say government boat operators are charging each person ₹100 to ₹150. A boatman said, "We were assigned work here three days ago. We were paid ₹1,000 that day. The administration promised to pay us ₹3,000 a day but is not giving us anything." The threat from snakes and other venomous creatures has also increased. Several diseases are spreading because of the filth. It is claimed that teams have been deployed for relief and healthcare services. Mobile medical units are distributing medicines, chlorine tablets and ORS. However, patients are having to be carried on cots. See the flood pictures-

stories.title: Annu Awasthi to contest from Sisamau:Holds ‘Dev Yatra’ in Kanpur with 50-vehicle convoy; says, ‘I will win by making people laugh’
stories.summary: Kanpur comedian Annu Awasthi announced that he would contest the election from the Sisamau seat. He said, "We will laugh our way to victory there and make the public laugh." In this connection, Annu Awasthi organised a Mitra Milan and Dev Yatra on Sunday. A convoy of more than 50 vehicles took part in the nearly 16-kilometre journey. MP Ramesh Awasthi and film actress Deepti Joshi were also present with Annu. Annu Awasthi said he was making a new beginning with the visit to the deity. "I have an old association with Sisamau," he said. It may be noted that Nasim Solanki is the MLA from Sisamau. The Samajwadi Party may field Nasim again in the next election. See 2 pictures... Annu Awasthi and Deepti Joshi rode in an open jeep Annu Awasthi began the Dev Yatra from the Curfew Car Market in Lajpat Nagar at around 3 p.m. on Sunday. Before the procession began, Annu's daughter Vanshika applied a tilak to him. BJP workers then carried him on their shoulders to the open jeep. During the procession, slogans of "Long live MP Ramesh Awasthi" and "Long live Annu Awasthi" were raised. Annu Awasthi boarded the open jeep. MP Ramesh Awasthi and television actress Deepti Joshi also boarded the jeep with him. Accompanied by a convoy of around 50 vehicles, the procession reached Deputy Padav via Gumti, Darshan Purwa and Deva Nagar. After offering prayers at the Chandrika Devi Temple there, the procession reached the Vankhandeshwar Temple in Sisamau Market. Annu Awasthi performed prayers at the temple. The procession then left for Chunniganj. During the approximately 16-kilometre journey, people carried saffron and tricolour flags. Golden Baba, also known as Manojanand Maharaj, also took part in the procession. Supporters and local people welcomed Annu Awasthi along the route. During the yatra, Annu Awasthi said, “We are making a new beginning with darshan at the temples. I was born in this area and have had a long association with the Vankhandeshwar Temple. People from this area used to win elections while making others cry. Now, their path has become difficult. We will win here by making people laugh and keep the public happy.” Awasthi said, “The people of the constituency have given me immense love, respect and honour. They have now become God for me. From today, I have become a devotee of the people of Sisamau. I will continue to work for them as long as I live.” MP Ramesh Awasthi said, “Our brother Annu Awasthi, a film actor who lives in the hearts of people in Kanpur, took out the Dev Darshan Yatra. I was also invited, which is why I came here.” Irfan Solanki’s family has held Sisamau seat for years Annu Awasthi has announced that he will contest from Kanpur’s Sisamau seat, which has long been held by Irfan Solanki’s family. His wife, Naseem Solanki, is currently the MLA from the constituency. Sisamau has a sizeable Muslim electorate. During the 1991 Ram wave, BJP’s Rakesh Sonkar became the MLA from the seat for the first time. He also won in 1993 and 1996. In 2002, however, Congress wrested the seat from the BJP and retained it in 2007. After the delimitation in 2012, the seat went to the Samajwadi Party, with Irfan Solanki, then an MLA from Arya Nagar, winning from Sisamau. Irfan won the seat again in 2017 and 2022. However, his membership was cancelled after he was convicted in the Jajmau arson case. In the subsequent bypoll, his wife Naseem Solanki defeated BJP’s Suresh Awasthi.

stories.title: Yogi renames Bhadohi district:Says it will now be known as Sant Ravidas Nagar Bhadohi; 5th name change in 32 years
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Sunday announced that Bhadohi district will now be known as ‘Sant Ravidas Nagar Bhadohi’. Speaking at the 50th India Carpet Expo, he said the district would henceforth be known by the new name. Earlier, on July 29, 2026, Yogi had announced in Varanasi that Bhadohi would be renamed ‘Sant Ravidas Nagar’. This is the fifth time Bhadohi’s name has been changed in 32 years. Referring to Sant Ravidas’ message from around 600 years ago, Yogi said he had envisioned a kingdom where everyone had enough food and people lived together without discrimination. He said that today, under Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s leadership, more than 800 million people in the country are receiving free ration. 12 districts in UP whose names were changed Now, know Yogi’s 9 key announcements… 1- University to be formally inaugurated The Chief Minister said Kashi Naresh Government Degree College has received university status. The process of affiliating colleges in the district with the university has also been completed. The university will soon be formally inaugurated and the foundation stone for a new building will be laid. 2- Sant Ravidas Nagar to be connected to Vindhya Expressway Under the expansion of the Ganga Expressway, directions have been issued to connect Sant Ravidas Nagar with the Vindhya Expressway. The DPR for the Madhosingh railway flyover is ready, and the tender process will begin soon. The Chief Minister said development should be carried out by taking everyone along. 3- ODOP gives carpets access to bigger markets The Chief Minister said the ODOP scheme has provided Bhadohi’s carpets with technology, better designs and access to larger markets. Now, 90% of the carpets made here are exported to countries including the US, Germany, Australia, Canada and the UK. 4- Silk cluster accounts for ₹6,100 crore in exports The silk clusters of Sant Ravidas Nagar, Mirzapur and Varanasi account for 60% of the country’s total carpet exports. Sant Ravidas Nagar alone has more than 2,500 MSME units, providing employment to over 5 lakh people. 5- Noida International Airport to be six hours away The Chief Minister said improved connectivity would benefit the carpet industry. After the expansion of the Vindhya Expressway, Noida International Airport will be around six hours away from Sant Ravidas Nagar. 6- No mafia can threaten traders now The Chief Minister said there is no longer an atmosphere of riots, curfews and mafia activity in the state. Traders and entrepreneurs are doing business in a secure environment. 7- Factories rise from 14,000 to over 35,000 He said Uttar Pradesh had around 14,000 factories before 2017, but the number has now crossed 35,000. The state has 96 lakh MSME units. 8- Bhadohi carpet laid in new Parliament building The Chief Minister said the carpet laid in the new Parliament building was also made in Sant Ravidas Nagar. The district has received facilities such as a GI tag, the ODOP platform and the Carpet Expo Mart. 9- International Trade Show showcased UP’s strength to the world According to the Chief Minister, more than 6 lakh people attended the UP International Trade Show held in Greater Noida. Over 2,400 exhibitors and more than 650 foreign buyers participated. Gifts of 112 projects worth ₹1,340 crore The Chief Minister inaugurated and laid the foundation stones for 112 projects worth over ₹1,340 crore across the Bhadohi, Aurai and Gyanpur Assembly constituencies. These include 65 inaugurated projects and 47 projects whose foundation stones were laid. The Chief Minister distributed cheques, house keys, appointment letters and Ayushman cards to beneficiaries of various schemes. ₹2 crore was given to Vineet Rai, ₹5 lakh to Pawan Kumar, ₹10 lakh to Gaurav Singh and ₹4.46 crore to Kajal Gautam. Jaydev was handed a house key, Neha and Prinsi received appointment letters as Anganwadi workers, and Jamanadevi was given an Ayushman card. The Chief Minister also inspected stalls set up by various departments. He conducted the annaprashan ceremony for children, performed the god bharai ceremony for pregnant women, and viewed models made by children at a science exhibition. Expo expects ₹500 crore in business Exporters from across the country have set up stalls showcasing their products at the 50th India Carpet Expo. According to the organisers, buyers from 65 countries are expected to attend, with business worth over ₹500 crore likely to be generated. The expo will be held from October 4 to 7.

stories.title: UP Rajya Sabha polls:BJP sends 24 names to Delhi for 8 seats, 2 Brahmin leaders likely
stories.summary: Polling for 10 Rajya Sabha seats in Uttar Pradesh is scheduled for 16 October. The BJP's state unit has sent the central leadership the names of 24 potential candidates for eight seats. Kripa Shankar Singh, who hails from Jaunpur, is also emerging as a contender. Kripa Shankar Singh served as Maharashtra's Minister of State for Home between 2009 and 2024. The BJP fielded him from the Jaunpur seat in the 2024 Lok Sabha election, although he suffered defeat there. Despite the loss, he has remained active in Jaunpur and the surrounding Purvanchal region. He is considered to have a strong support base among the North Indian community, particularly people from Uttar Pradesh living in Mumbai and Maharashtra. The BP may consider sending him to the Rajya Sabha as part of a strategy to balance the regional and caste equations in Purvanchal. BJP focuses on Brahmin community, 7 prominent names in race for 2 seats According to the panel, Brahmin candidates are almost certain to be given an opportunity for 2 of the 8 Rajya Sabha seats. The party's objective behind this is to reach out to the educated section and send a political message. The prominent names from the Brahmin quota that have been sent to the central leadership include: The contest between these veterans is neck and neck, and the final decision will be taken at the BJP Central Election Committee meeting in Delhi. Jayant Chaudhary preparing to respond to the SP The BJP may give one Rajya Sabha seat to its NDA ally, the RLD. However, an interesting situation has emerged regarding RLD president and Union minister Jayant Chaudhary. Jayant Chaudhary was elected to the Rajya Sabha with the SP's support. A few days ago, SP chief Akhilesh Yadav took a swipe at Jayant, saying, "Those whom I had turned from half-rupees and quarter-rupees into rupees have now left me and gone." Strategists in the RLD and BJP fear that Akhilesh Yadav and the SP could once again exploit the issue in the upcoming Assembly election by alleging that Jayant is in the Rajya Sabha only because of the SP's support. Jayant's supporters want him to resign from his current term and win a fresh Rajya Sabha election with the BJP's support, thereby countering the Opposition's allegations. There is also intense speculation that Jayant's wife, Charu Chaudhary, could be sent to the Rajya Sabha in his place, although no official party source has formally confirmed this so far.
